style_summary: High-density sci-fi film poster language built from teal-green paper, giant vermilion title glyphs, cream highlights and ink-black halftone; it keeps occlusion, misregistration and wear while reorganizing the layout around new stories at different scales.

environment_variables.ASPECT_RATIO: 9:16 or 16:9. Recompose for the selected ratio.
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Runtime joined CORE then FLEX anchors.
environment_variables.SUBJECT: Concrete original character, creature, object or environment for the fictional film.
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: Exact two-character CJK film title; primary text.
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Theme-driven hierarchy and separate portrait/landscape composition intentions.

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Use faded jade and turquoise grounds, hot vermilion type, near-black petrol shadows and butter-paper highlights as separated printing inks.
[CORE] Model dimensional subjects with visible coarse halftone dots and compressed tonal bands instead of smooth digital shading.
[CORE] Make oversized heavy CJK glyphs and the subject occlude one another while the exact primary title remains recognizable.
[CORE] Keep nearly the entire sheet active with overlapping image, typography and marginal texture-text planes.
[CORE] Preserve ink loss, scratched broken edges, modest plate misregistration and dense damaged caption blocks.
[FLEX] Change silhouette, camera distance and perspective to express each new narrative.
[FLEX] Arrange the title vertically, laterally, split or overprinted according to the subject and ratio.
[FLEX] Vary dark and cream ink coverage while keeping the jade-vermilion opposition dominant.
source_content_to_avoid: The white bob-haired blindfolded android and its distinctive character identity.
The black gothic puff-sleeved dress and rear three-quarter figure pose.
The diagonal katana and sword-bearing combat premise.
The original headline, exact page layout, seals, creator marks, logos and watermarks.

visual_deconstruction.hierarchy: Massive red glyphs compete with a dimensional, tightly cropped subject. Small text is surface rhythm.
visual_deconstruction.negative_space: Minimal; quiet areas retain colored paper and visible printing patterns.

energy.density: Essential: matches near-full active surface with huge glyphs, subject and dense marginal text.
energy.layering: Essential: matches or exceeds three visibly overlapping image, type and print-texture planes.
energy.disorder: Essential: matches moderate ink loss, rough boundaries and plate misregistration; not randomized collage debris.
energy.tension: Essential: matches cropped scale collisions, asymmetry and subject/type competition.

composition.system: One dominant narrative form, enormous CJK type and marginal print matter interlock. The focal structure changes for every case.
composition.ratio_adaptation: Portrait favors vertical mass or plunging space. Landscape expands lateral movement and redistributes type; do not crop the portrait mechanically.
composition.freedom: Title location, subject crop, camera angle and ink coverage are case-dependent.

typography.primary: Two-character title in massive heavy display CJK forms, blocky counters, short wedge-like terminals and distressed red edges. Readable despite deliberate partial occlusion.
typography.texture: Dense fictional credit blocks, small vertical captions, digits and broken rules are graphic matter; they may repeat, fade or be unreadable. Avoid copied seals and recognizable marks.
typography.relationship: Type may sit behind, overprint or traverse the image; avoid a tidy headline/subtitle/footer template.

image_treatment.process: Dimensional semi-realistic illustration reduced to rough screen-print separations.
image_treatment.texture: Visible coarse round/irregular halftones, roughly 1–4 pixels at the 736-pixel reference width, following tonal form; medium-heavy on the subject and background. Moderate abrasion and ink loss on red glyphs, thin misregistration at selected edges and mottled aged-paper softness are intentional. Do not substitute uniformly sprayed noise or polished gradients.
image_treatment.lighting: Hard directional cream light and broad near-black shadows; retain tactile form under the print process.

design_rules: Maintain the jade-vermilion opposition and a small shared ink vocabulary.
Keep primary titles exact while allowing decorative texture text to fragment.
Require meaningful subject/type occlusion and active peripheral print matter.
Give every case a distinct silhouette and narrative scale.
Recompose each ratio with its specified title/image interaction.
do: Use coarse dots as tonal structure.
Allow clipped silhouettes, uneven alignments and worn overprint.
Let story meaning change scale and typography placement.
avoid: Clean vector poster surfaces or smooth gradient rendering.
Repeated centered hero plus neatly separated title layouts.
Copied original character, sword, identity marks or source headline.
negative_prompt: Smooth CGI; clean vector flatness; evenly spaced grid; sparse luxury layout; English imperative slogans; repeated centered figure; original android, dress or katana; copied source headline or identity marks; watermark; illegible primary title.

values.SUBJECT: An adult East Asian woman salvage diver in a battered spherical diving helmet and bulky pressure collar, seen in tight side profile; the visor frames a calm face, oxidized metal catches cream light.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the helmet a trapped pale moon against a heavy dark shoulder, with red characters partly behind the helmet and cutting across the lower collar. Portrait: towering helmet/profile close-up with descending title. Landscape: broad lateral helmet profile against two oversized offset title masses; crop the shoulder hard.

values.SUBJECT: A gigantic ribbon-shaped oarfish with a dark ridged spine and pale bony head bends over a tiny working ferry carrying one hooded pilot on black water; uncanny scale, no gore.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Let the serpent thread between the red glyphs so their apertures feel like dangerous gates. Portrait: long descending S-curve, tiny ferry near a low crossing. Landscape: arch the head and serpentine body across the full width above the off-center boat; keep the background dense with inked current patterns.

values.SUBJECT: A single antique industrial horn loudspeaker, torn paper cone, chipped ceramic throat, exposed coil and cracked metal bell, dramatically foreshortened; no human figure.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The black cone is a visual abyss: red title strokes overlap its rim and broken membranes while the title remains readable. Portrait: enormous diagonal mouth, barrel clipped by an edge. Landscape: stretch the bell and barrel sideways, place the two glyphs at competing scales across and behind the mouth. Keep it cinematic, never a clean product advertisement.

values.SUBJECT: An impossible dense brutalist megacity of stacked service towers, bridge ducts and window cells, with one minute rain-caped courier crossing a precarious bridge.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Bold case: push scale jumps and overprint beyond the reference; building-sized vermilion characters cut in front of and disappear behind architecture. Portrait: plunge through a narrow vertical urban chasm. Landscape: compressed city wall across the frame cut by a diagonal elevated bridge. Make the tiny courier a barely spared light silhouette; the glyphs remain readable and visibly collide with concrete.
